# ExitPass POS Server Annex E-1 Synthetic UAT Canonical Source Row Population v1.6

## 1. Construction language

This document closes all 29 canonical row families. A future offline constructor must implement these expressions exactly and reject unresolved values.

| Expression | Exact meaning |
|---|---|
| `ID(token,o)` | UUIDv5 of `annex-e1-synthetic-uat:v1.1\|AE1-UAT-NNN\|token\|OOOO` in namespace `ae1d5e7a-7e2d-5c4d-9a11-202608140001` |
| `REF(type,o)` | UUIDv5 of `annex-e1-synthetic-reference:v1\|AE1-UAT-NNN\|type\|OOOO` in the same namespace; opaque reference, not a registry row |
| `NULL` | AE1H null; SQL-shaped nullable value is null |
| `EMPTY_OBJECT` | AE1H object with zero members; runtime JSON `{}` |
| `SETUP(k)` | `2026-09-01T00:00:00.0000000Z + NNN minutes + k seconds` |
| `PSTART(p)` | `2026-09-09T16:00:00.0000000Z + (p-1) days` |
| `PEND(p)` | `PSTART(p) + 1 day` |
| `DOC(o,p)` | `PSTART(p) + 9 hours + (o-1) seconds`, except case 004 document 0002 equals `PSTART(2)` |
| `XAT(p)` | `PEND(p) - 29 seconds` |
| `ZAT(p)` | `PEND(p) + 11 seconds` |
| `BIRAT(p)` | `PEND(p) + 13 seconds` |
| `FACTAT(f,p)` | `PEND(p) - 10 seconds + f milliseconds` |
| `FACTREC(f,p)` | `PEND(p) + 14 seconds + global-f milliseconds` |
| `AUDITAT(o)` | source event time plus 200 milliseconds, or `SETUP(1000+o)` for setup evidence |
| `HASH(row)` | source/evidence hash under the v1.4 AE1H family, excluding self-hash fields |
| `RUNTIME_HASH(row)` | current source canonicalizer named in the hash contract |

`NNN`, `p`, `o`, and `f` are fixed by the scenario mapping. All timestamps are UTC with seven fractional digits. Strings are literal and case-sensitive. `uuid`, `int64`, `int32`, `bool`, `date`, `time`, `timestamp`, `code`, `string`, `decimal(9,6)`, `binary32`, `object`, and ordered `array<T>` are the only types.

## 2. Universal literals

| Name | Literal |
|---|---|
| actor | `synthetic-data-steward` |
| service | `pos-server-annex-e1-uat-preparer` |
| runtime service | `pos-server-fiscal-document-runtime` |
| currency | `PHP` |
| timezone | `Asia/Manila` |
| taxpayer | `SYNTHETIC ANNEX E1 PARKING SERVICES INC.` |
| address | `100 SYNTHETIC AVENUE, TEST CITY 0000` |
| TIN | `000-000-000-000` |
| calculation profile | `pos-server-annex-e1-accounting-calculation:v1` |
| accounting approval | `SYN-AE1-ACCOUNTING-V13` |
| privacy | `SYNTHETIC_FISCAL_FACTS` |
| retention | `fiscal_reconstruction_hold` |

Codes and references are `SYN-AE1-SPS-NNN`, `SYN-AE1-FI-NNN`, `SYN-AE1-SERIAL-NNN`, `SYN-AE1-MIN-NNN`, series `SI-NNN`, document `SYN-AE1-SI-NNN-OOOO`, payment attempt `SYN-AE1-PAYMENT-NNN-OOOO`, confirmation `SYN-AE1-CONFIRM-NNN-OOOO`, finality `SYN-AE1-FINALITY-NNN-OOOO`, document operation `SYN-AE1-DOC-NNN-OOOO`, void operation `SYN-AE1-VOID-NNN-0004`, and case correlation `DS-AE1-NNN`. Parking identity is not an alias: it is `REF(parking-session,o)` and every string representation is its lowercase RFC 4122 `D` form.

All optional customer, vehicle, beneficiary, evidence, credential, external endpoint, provider, vendor, reprint, signature, encryption, correction-workbook, and raw-payload fields are `NULL`. No blank string stands for null.

### 2.1 Exact reusable ordered schemas

These names are schema macros, not implementation shorthand. Substitution inserts the listed members at the reference position in this exact order and with these exact AE1H types.

`SCOPE_V14` = `site_pos_server_id:uuid=ID(site-pos-server,1)`; `fiscal_identity_id:uuid=ID(fiscal-identity,1)`; `period_id:uuid=ID(period,p)`; `currency:code=PHP`.

`REPORT_SNAPSHOT_V14` = `gross_sales_minor_units:int64`; `net_sales_minor_units:int64`; `vatable_sales_minor_units:int64`; `vat_amount_minor_units:int64`; `vat_exempt_sales_minor_units:int64=0`; `zero_rated_sales_minor_units:int64=0`; `senior_citizen_discount_minor_units:int64`; `pwd_discount_minor_units:int64`; `naac_discount_minor_units:int64=0`; `solo_parent_discount_minor_units:int64=0`; `other_statutory_discount_minor_units:int64=0`; `coupon_discount_minor_units:int64`; `promotional_discount_minor_units:int64=0`; `void_amount_minor_units:int64`; `refund_amount_minor_units:int64=0`; `transaction_count:int64`; `void_count:int64`; `refund_count:int64=0`; `first_sequence:int64`; `last_sequence:int64`; `first_document_number:string`; `last_document_number:string`; `tender_total_minor_units:int64`; `discount_total_minor_units:int64`. Values are the exact A13/B13/D13 profile values in the source matrix; B13/D13 discount and void members are zero. This is a 24-member object.

`REPORT_CHILDREN_V14` = `fiscal_ranges:array<binary32>` containing family-5 semantic digests in range ordinal order; `tender_breakdowns:array<binary32>` containing family-13 semantic digests in classification order `cash`, `digital_wallet`; `discount_breakdowns:array<binary32>` containing family-14 semantic digests in order `coupon`, `PWD`, `SENIOR_CITIZEN`. Inapplicable arrays are present and empty. Duplicate digests are forbidden.

`ACTOR_V14` = `actor:string=synthetic-data-steward`; `service:string=pos-server-annex-e1-uat-preparer`; `correlation_id:string=DS-AE1-NNN`.

`POLICY_V14` = `resolution_basis:code=NATIONAL_LAW`; `applied_policy_id:uuid=REF(policy-reference,o)`; `policy_code:code=SYN-AE1-STATUTORY-POLICY-V13`; `policy_version_id:uuid=NULL`; `national_law:code=RA_9994_OR_RA_10754`; `ordinance:code=NULL`. The name is v1.6 package-local; the controlled policy code is preserved from v1.3.

`ANNEX_HEADERS_V14` is the ordered object H01 through H10 from the expected-value matrix, each as `string`. `ANNEX_DETAILS_V14` is the ordered object D01 through D32; dates and document numbers are `string`, D32 is `code`, and D04 through D31 except date/number fields are `int64` minor units/counts. `RECONCILIATIONS_V14` is an ordered array R01 through R12 of objects `{rule:code,expected_minor_units:int64,calculated_minor_units:int64,difference_minor_units:int64,expected_row_count:int64,calculated_row_count:int64,row_count_difference:int64,result:code=PASS}`. Nonmonetary R08-R10 use zero for both monetary members and their exact expected/calculated relation counts.

## 5. Definitive semantic-instance registry

This v1.6 registry replaces both v1.4 Appendix A and Appendix B. The v1.4 informational binding digests, their lengths, and their registry commitment are not carried forward. Identity routing remains available in the non-cryptographic key, UUID, scenario, ordinal, and token columns. Only the complete source/runtime semantic evidence in Appendix A establishes closure.

The semantic envelope is the stable `annex-e1-source-row` / `sha256:v1.4` AE1H wire profile. Package version v1.6 does not alter that established row framing. `AE1H-SOURCE-ROW-v1.4` means root members `rowId:uuid`, `role:code`, and `fields:object` in that order. The exact family token is published per row. Schema Base64 is strict UTF-8 compact JSON of the ordered `{n,t}` pairs. Values Base64 is strict UTF-8 compact JSON of the ordered `{n,t,v}` records. Together they independently determine every preimage byte; the published preimage hexadecimal value is comparison evidence only.

Null is represented only by `null:<declared-type>` with JSON null. Missing members do not occur. Empty string, empty object, empty array, binary zero bytes, integer zero, and Boolean false remain distinct. Arrays and objects retain the order in their value records. No implicit default or external value is permitted.

## 6. Request and audit registries

The 346 operation requests are exactly: 67 document creates, 15 voids, 22 X, 22 Z, 22 BIR, 155 Accounting facts, 31 Annex attempts, and 12 access attempts. Within each case they are ordered document creates, optional void, period-ordered X/Z/BIR, Accounting facts, Annex attempts, then access attempts. Each request UUID uses `ID(operation-request,o)` and fields are operation key, exact Site/fiscal/period or year/month scope, profile/version, actor, service, case correlation, and exact source IDs. No authority override exists.

The 31 Annex attempts are one per case; a second in 012, 013, 014, 016, and 024; and seven additional attempts in 021. The 12 access attempts are: 001 deterministic export; 011 integrity verify; 014 restart read; 016 missing and tampered download; 018 metadata read and download; 019 wrong-scope metadata read and download; 023 privacy metadata inspect; 024 orphan lookup and post-retry metadata read.

The 186 audit rows are the 155 fact-created audits, 19 workbook-created audits, and those 12 access audits. Access outcomes are: allowed for 001, 011, 014, both 018, 023, and post-retry 024; denied `NOT_FOUND` and `INTEGRITY_MISMATCH` for 016; denied `SCOPE_MISMATCH` for both 019; denied `ORPHAN_INACCESSIBLE` for first 024. Each safe reason is that exact uppercase token.

## 8. Closure result

All 29 families and all 1,690 instances are published in the single Appendix A registry. Independent author-side reconstruction decoded each row's ordered schema and value tuple, rebuilt AE1H without using the published preimage hexadecimal bytes, and compared names, types, values, length, complete bytes, and SHA-256. Results are 840 preserved v1.4 rows, 148 incorporated F22 rows, 702 newly corrected rows, 1,690 unique keys, 1,690 unique governed UUIDs, zero duplicate/missing/unexpected rows, zero unnamed/untyped members, zero ordering ambiguity, zero source-value mismatch, zero length mismatch, zero preimage mismatch, zero digest mismatch, and zero blocked instances. IR14-01 and IR14-02 are author-side resolved; E14-01 is corrected. Current-runtime request and EJ integrity digests remain governed by their named source canonicalizers and are not replaced by these AE1H source-row digests.
